title: Ulysses Browne of Camus
html_source: Maximilian Ulysses Brown was an Austrian military leader whose father was from Limerick and among the Wild Geese who went to fight for Catholicism on the continent.

anchor.prefix: . Remember Limerick and the broken treatystone. We gave our best blood to France and Spain, the wild geese. Fontenoy, eh? And Sarsfield and O'Donnell, duke of Tetuan in Spain, and
anchor.suffix:
